question.text: Will the U.S.-China tariff truce be extended past 2026-08-31?

documents.title: U.S.-China tariff truce nears expiry
documents.text: The existing U.S.-China tariff truce is set to expire on August 31; negotiators are discussing an extension of the trade agreement.

documents.title: MOFCOM statement signals constructive talks
documents.text: China's MOFCOM described talks as constructive and expressed intent to de-escalate and extend the tariff truce.

documents.title: Sticking points remain on enforcement
documents.text: Reports note unresolved enforcement issues that could delay any extension of the China tariff truce.

documents.title: USTR announces 90-day extension of U.S.-China tariff truce
documents.text: USTR announced a 90-day extension of the U.S.-China tariff truce, a de-escalation avoiding new tariffs.
